notes.title: - Dino Run 2 Progress Update -
notes.notes: [p]Hello All,[/p][p align="start"]Time for another update regarding our progress on [b]Dino Run 2[/b]![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751000/16340a75fdcc63409c902a52a10b5f4190094efc.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Kickstarter Campaign[/b][/h3][p align="start"]Things are rolling along well, and we've reached four of our funding goals so far. If you want to throw it some support, [url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.kickstarter.com%2Fprojects%2Fpixeljam%2Fthe-dino-run-2-early-access-campaign%3Fref%3D9aoxr8" style="button"]Click here to check it out[/url]. Next funding goal will unlock the [b]Jungle Homestead[/b], which adds a new biome and placeable objects to your domestic endeavors in the Dino Run universe:[/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751000/77fe35b9fb49ca9a525ff86013349858309fcf3d.png"][/img][/h3][h3][b]Multiplayer Sandbox[/b][/h3][p align="start"]We're weeks away from launching [b]Pivots[/b], which will allow you to pin any object to the world and rotate around it. [b]All backers of the Kickstarter campaign get immediate access to the sandbox.[/b] With pivots you can start to make your prehistoric engineering ideas come to life:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751000/e51365e241fa5fc03758ed1eaa005922b59e07d6.gif"][/img][/p][h3][b]What's Next[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Level Generator:[/b] Define parameters and "roll" a level until you like the way it looks, then enter it and start adding on objects and decorations.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Doomwall 1.0:[/b] a basic version of the doom to add the necessary urgency that Dino Runners demand...[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Many more of our future tasks can be seen on the ROADMAP in the [b][url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.kickstarter.com%2Fprojects%2Fpixeljam%2Fthe-dino-run-2-early-access-campaign%3Fref%3D9aoxr8"]kickstarter campaign[/url].[/b] We're going to keep on with it until it's ready to launch into Early Access in 2026. Thanks again for the patience and support![/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][i]-Miles @ Pixeljam[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751000/1d767de6726e7a617b7c68b76154f13781d1a1d2.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Pixeljam have launched a new Kickstarter to get Dino Run 2 ready for Early Access
notes.notes:
Dino Run 2 is finally actually happening, with the latest Kickstarter aiming to get enough funds to make it ready for Early Access.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/09/pixeljam-have-launched-a-new-kickstarter-to-get-dino-run-2-ready-for-early-access/

notes.title: The Dino Run 2 Kickstarter Is Live!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello all,[/p][p]We just launched the Dino Run 2 Early Access Kickstarter Campaign.  Check it out here: [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/pixeljam/the-dino-run-2-early-access-campaign?ref=9aoxr8"]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/pixeljam/the-dino-run-2-early-access-campaign?ref=9aoxr8[/url][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751000/99274ea444b356efb94e7d35b7844e9e47ebc867.png"][/img][/p][p]We've been working on this game (and campaign) for a very long time, as many of you know. This is the big moment where we gather all dino-fans and rally around making the Dino Run 2 Early Access launch as awesome as possible.[/p][p][b]All backers $10 and over will get immediate access to the Multiplayer Sandbox[/b], where you can explore and experiment, design & destroy, hang out and have fun alone or with friends.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751000/3f1c7e23b2f891a3e5051580a3045158574ade27.gif"][/img][/p][p][i]Please note that we cannot give Steam Keys to backers until the game launches on Steam, which will be sometime in 2026.  We'll supply a direct download link for now.[/i][/p][p]Show us what you've made with it in the ⁠[b]dr2_sandbox_creations[/b] channel on [url="https://discord.gg/pixeljam" style="button"]Discord[/url] as well. The community is already creating some pretty impressive stuff, and they often share their save-files so you can check them out yourself...[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751000/f7daf40371f1ce3d195866d7ccf7546dbbf54ae2.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Please share the campaign far and wide![/b] We'll gladly accept as much support and funding as the world would like to give... it will all make the game that much better.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for the (potential) support![/p][p]
[i]-Miles @ Pixeljam[/i][/p]

notes.title: Long-awaited prehistoric multiplayer platformer Dino Run 2 is heading back to Kickstarter with a new demo
notes.notes:
After some setbacks, Pixeljam are readying a fresh Kickstarter to help fund the prehistoric multiplayer racing platformer Dino Run 2, along with a fresh demo.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/08/long-awaited-prehistoric-multiplayer-platformer-dino-run-2-is-heading-back-to-kickstarter-with-a-new-demo/

notes.title: The Multiplayer Sandbox Is Ready / Kickstarter Campaign Announced!
notes.notes: [p]Hello all,[/p][p]We've been hard at work on Dino Run 2 since the last announcement, and we're happy to report that the [b]Multiplayer Sandbox[/b] is ready to distribute to all backers, patrons and funders.  We start rolling it out today![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751000/1652edf1946a62ee1f7b0287cda9eb50ec6f0305.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]If you supported the campaign in the past, be on the lookout for an email, Discord ping, Kickstarter update or Patreon post in the coming days.[/p][p][/p][p]We're also about to launch a Kickstarter campaign on September 2 to help us get to Early Access launch, and you can follow it here: [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/pixeljam/the-dino-run-2-early-access-campaign"][b]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/pixeljam/the-dino-run-2-early-access-campaign[/b][/url][/p][p][i][b]Everyone that pledges to this campaign will get immediate access to the Multiplayer Sandbox, regardless of the campaign reaching its funding goal.[/b][/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751000/e4ba0409d73b0ccd74e431d71eeb3630ce8ff58e.png"][/img][/p][p]If you have access to it now, we hope you enjoy the new build - it's massively improved from the last version.  if you don't, you'll be able to play it in September![/p][p][/p][p]Take care,[/p][p][/p][p][i]-Miles @ Pixeljam[/i][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Sandbox Mega-Update!
notes.notes:
Hello all,

We recently made a major update to the Sandbox Alpha, available to all current supporters:

[b]Raptor:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added tail whap ability 
[*] Improved raptor collisions
[*] Added several new idle animations
[*] Raptor's feet now adapt to terrain while idle
[*] Raptor now blinks procedurally
[*] Added crouching
[*] Added pounce animation
[*] Added vanity station for changing the raptor's color palette and patterns
[/list]

[b]Sandbox:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added several new placeable objects
[*] Added several decorative placeables (Ferns, trees, etc.)
[*] Added a flavor selector for placeables (bouncy, icy, etc)
[*] Added palette swapping and flavor variations to almost all placeable objects
[/list]

[b]Misc:[/b]
[list]
[*] Expanded the start cave into a new sanctuary
[*] Added a debug console
[*] Dragonflies now come in several colors
[*] Supporters list is updated automatically
[/list]

Check the video for what this actually looks like: [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YXM-fPwW228]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YXM-fPwW228[/url]

We're steadily working towards bringing this (and much more) over to Early Access sometime in 2025.

[i]-Miles @ Pixeljam[/i]

notes.title: A Wild Dino Run 2 Spotted On Steam! Read This And Get Ready...
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751000/7b5f608cd96e3f2595d6bec0c1e01f49eb546425.png[/img]

[h3][b]Dino Run 2 has been a long time coming.[/b][/h3]

We dreamt it up over 10 years ago, ran an over-ambitious kickstarter for it in 2013 (which did not reach its goal), and followed it up with a very realistic campaign in 2019, which saw enough success to get us tinkering with the game's basic systems from 2019 to 2022.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751000/ce64cbc667eb4e2734d3ad8a84add3bf1b2a6425.png[/img]

Development was rocky during that time though, to put it mildly. Mid-2022 we pushed the RESET button and started from scratch.  With the help of some new team members, the success of Nova Drift and the ongoing [url=https://www.pixeljam.com/dinorun/][b]crowdfunding campaign[/b][/url], we have arrived where we are now, the [b]SANDBOX ALPHA[/b], which is totally playable and a solid foundation to the larger Dino Run 2 experience:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751000/9395ce1ff2fdfaeacf30f93eca09a2a129238348.gif[/img]

However, it's not ready for Steam yet.  We'll be updating the current playable over the next year or so getting it *just* right for its big debut.

In the meantime, If you want to check out the current playable build, head on over to that campaign link above :)

Here's to a great (prehistoric) future!

[i]-Miles @ Pixeljam[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751000/f12ea75201dc7c2b9e61c7e12e87ab3e47c9514e.png[/img]
